name: Marie Louise, Duchess of Parma
role: Empress of the French from 1810 to 1814
contribution: Duchess of Parma from 11 April 1814 until her death in 1847.

checks.lead: Marie Louise (Maria Ludovica Leopoldina Franziska Theresia Josepha Lucia; 12 December 1791 – 17 December 1847) was Duchess of Parma from 11 April 1814 until her death in 1847. She was Napoleon's second wife and as such Empress of the French and Queen of Italy from their marriage on 2 April 1810 until his abdication on 6 April 1814.
